title: YouTube Channel Email & Contact Scraper
description: Discover YouTube channels by URL or niche and return public contact records (emails, phones, websites, socials). Prefer the default public scrape. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

channelUrls.title: YouTube channel URLs
channelUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides specific YouTube channel names, handles, or URLs (e.g. '@mkbhd', 'youtube.com/@MrBeast', a list of creators). Accepts @handle URLs, /channel/ID URLs, or video URLs. Each URL = 1 channel scraped. Use channelUrls when the user says 'get emails for these channels', 'scrape this list of YouTubers', or 'find contact info for [specific creator]'. You can combine with searchQueries.

searchQueries.title: Search by niche or keyword (auto-discover channels)
searchQueries.description: Use this field when the user describes a niche, topic, or industry instead of specific channels (e.g. 'fitness influencers', 'tech reviewers', 'cooking YouTube channels'). The actor searches YouTube and auto-discovers matching channels. Use searchQueries when the user says 'find YouTube channels about X', 'build me a list of influencers in [niche]', 'discover creators who cover [topic]', or 'get emails for [industry] YouTubers'. Each query returns up to 20 channels. VibeLeads scope: qualify companies first. Optional contact extraction stays disabled in discovery; enable only a reviewed, relevant contact stage for named qualified businesses under the contact-use gate. Provider bounds are not recommended volumes or permission.

maxResults.title: Maximum channels to scrape
maxResults.description: How many YouTube channels to extract contact data from in total (across all URLs and search queries combined). Set to 10–20 for a quick test. A channel with a public email charges the $0.05 Channel Result event. Default: 100 channels. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate. VibeLeads scope: qualify companies first. Optional contact extraction stays disabled in discovery; enable only a reviewed, relevant contact stage for named qualified businesses under the contact-use gate. Provider bounds are not recommended volumes or permission.

scrapeWebsite.title: Read public website contacts
scrapeWebsite.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
